findings.title: MCP launcher copied from cache without signature re-verification
findings.trigger: MCP plugin install/refresh copies cache binary to the stable launcher path
findings.impact: Planted binary becomes the process external AI clients spawn with secrets in reach
findings.root_cause: Deletion of the downloader removed the only verification call site; the copy path had none
findings.exploitability: Requires prior local write; raises bar specifically against cache-planting
findings.recommended_fix: Verify manifest sha256 + Ed25519 at the copy boundary, fail closed in release
findings.validation: cargo check + unit tests; manual review
findings.residual_risk: Pre-existing launcher on disk not re-verified at boot (equivalent to same-user code exec). Fleet follow-up closed the verify/copy TOCTOU: the gate now writes the exact verified bytes.

findings.title: Inherited half-transformation: broken build, silent SQL column shift, INSERT arity bug

source_locations: connections.rs SELECT lists vs row-mapper indexes
commands: cargo check -p oryxis-vault (38 errors at intake)

findings.trigger: Any vault save (SQL arity) or connection list read (column shift)
findings.impact: Runtime SQL error on save; silent field mis-mapping on read
findings.root_cause: Partial deletion of cloud columns without completing the positional plumbing
findings.implemented_fix: Direct pinned URL fetch; NULL sentinels at retired SELECT positions; INSERT renumbered 65/65
findings.residual_risk: None known; round-trip tests cover the mapper

findings.title: AI assistant sends terminal context to third-party LLM
findings.trigger: Explicit user invocation with configured provider + API key
findings.implemented_fix: Retained as Controlled-Network carve-out (default-off, user endpoint/key, redaction, judge fail-safe)
findings.residual_risk: Operators who configure a provider accept the disclosed egress

findings.title: Opt-in vault master password embed in ~/.claude.json
findings.implemented_fix: Retained by design; documented operating condition (decline the embed)
findings.residual_risk: Plaintext secret on disk in client config

findings.title: ProxyCommand sh -c from ssh_config
findings.trigger: Connecting through a host whose ssh_config defines ProxyCommand
findings.implemented_fix: Per-dial consent dialog + fingerprint trust set (pre-existing, retained)

findings.title: Silent boot-time font fetch for configured terminal font
findings.trigger: Configured pack font missing on disk at boot, or CJK language selected
findings.implemented_fix: Kept: commit-pinned URLs, SHA-256+length pin, size cap, https-only, atomic install, vendor-mirror layer removed
findings.residual_risk: Network observer learns a font was fetched (no content sensitivity)

findings.title: Dependency trust concentrates in maintainer forks
findings.implemented_fix: Verified exact-rev pinning; accepted residual under documented threat model
findings.residual_risk: Compromised fork rev compiles into the binary

findings.title: Dev plugin-signing seed is public
findings.implemented_fix: None needed: dev key trusted only under debug_assertions; prod key compile-time overridable, all-zero key rejected

findings.title: Advisory-database scan not performed
findings.implemented_fix: Lockfile pinning verified; SBOM generated; runbook step defined for operators with cargo-audit
findings.residual_risk: Unknown CVEs in dependency tree unquantified here

findings.title: Dynamic network-denial rehearsal not performed
findings.implemented_fix: Static egress proof + rehearsal scripts provided (network-policy/); verdict capped at CONDITIONAL PASS

findings.implemented_fix: None needed: OpenUrl only, no automated fetch
